body: Claim: core 1.0.1 (PATCH) for session core-1.0.1. Paths I will edit: core/bin/ledger-gates, core/bin/ledger-gates.ps1 (gate verdict: propagate pipeline failures via pipefail where the shell supports it; reject unverifiable top-level pipelines otherwise; verdict = exit code OR failure signal), core/bin/ledger-sync + ledger-sync.ps1 (verify gains a port parse check: ParseFile over core/bin/*.ps1 + sh -n over the sh ports), new tests/run-tests.sh (package test: gated failing-cmd|tee must fail the gate, both editions), core/VERSION -> 1.0.1, core/CHANGELOG.md entry, core/MANIFEST.sha256 regen; then self-host via ledger-sync update core. Encoding/cp1252 handling is Kai's 1.0.2 scope — out of my diff.
